spec.description: 95% of dex-api /api requests succeed in under 2 seconds, over a rolling 28 days. 2s leaves room for a route that does two or three Elasticsearch Serverless writes at about 0.5s each (docs/incidents.md, incident 4). A failed request counts as bad however fast it was.

spec.query: histogram_fraction(0, 2, increase({otel_metric_name="dash0.spans.duration", service_name="dex-api", otel_span_kind="SERVER", http_route=~"/api/.*", otel_span_status_code!="ERROR"}[5m])) * histogram_count(increase({otel_metric_name="dash0.spans.duration", service_name="dex-api", otel_span_kind="SERVER", http_route=~"/api/.*", otel_span_status_code!="ERROR"}[5m]))

objectives.displayName: 95% of API requests succeed in under 2s
